verdicts.decision_note: The freelancer identifies material uncertainty about the bushing installation, retention, fit, and assembly operation.
The client specifies the bushing location, clearance fit, internal rod arrangement, and POS 4 connection.
The client provides an actionable arrangement resolving the preceding assembly uncertainty.
The client clarifies the guided member, gives a specific clearance example, and limits the sliding part to the piston end; the replaced generic fit key is validly removed.
The messages establish material uncertainty about how the clearance-fit bushing is retained and whether it moves with the rod.

The client selects a provisional arrangement in which the rod nut retains the bushing at the sliding end and the bushing slides inside the shaft; the removed prior attributes conflict with that arrangement.
The client directs the freelancer to use the selected arrangement for the current drawings, resolving the retention uncertainty for current work.
The freelancer identifies an unresolved design choice concerning retention or removal of the bushing and sliding-mandrel holes.
The immediately preceding question unambiguously establishes that the client directs both sets of existing holes to be retained.
The client resolves the hole-retention uncertainty with an actionable decision.
